title: Venison Pileau
ingredients: ["4 c. cooked venison (boneless)", "1/4 lb. bacon, chopped in small pieces, fried", "2 c. long-grain rice", "3 cans (14 1/2 oz.) Swanson's clear beef broth", "2 medium onions, chopped", "2 oz. fresh mushrooms, chopped", "* salt and pepper to taste"]
directions: ["* Kitchen Bouqet or instant coffee to darken rice if desired."]
